moments.evidence: Un pal travesser impedeix que un cotxe de joguina baixi per la rampa.
Aixeca el pal pels extrems. El cotxe comença a passar per l’espai obert sota el pal.
El cotxe és al peu de la rampa. El pal continua alçat a la mateixa alçada.

continuity.anchor: Un cotxe amb capó vermell, un pal rom i una rampa curta amb vores.

attempts.prompt: Generate exactly ONE finished educational causal-sequence raster image with a wide landscape horizontal triptych. Exactly THREE equal side by side panels separated by generous plain white gutters, no border. Every element is comfortably in frame with white margins. Photorealistic synthetic studio photography, a natural adult man in plain clothes, with human anatomy. Same single agent, facial identity, clothing, sizes, scale, white backdrop, camera angle, furniture and objects in all three panels. Keep important objects large and sharply legible while keeping all three full actors visible. Catalan content specification, translate visually: LEFT (initial state): Un pal travesser impedeix que un cotxe de joguina baixi per la rampa. CENTER (explicit physical mechanism): Aixeca el pal pels extrems. El cotxe comença a passar per l’espai obert sota el pal. RIGHT (consequence): El cotxe és al peu de la rampa. El pal continua alçat a la mateixa alçada. Count and continuity: Un cotxe amb capó vermell, un pal rom i una rampa curta amb vores. Show rails and straight wooden crossbar edge-on so contact and clearance are unmistakable. The toy car is stationary against bar first, half a car-length past its former position in panel 2, and resting on the floor in panel 3. No words, letters, digits, arrows, motion-line marks, numbers, branding or watermark. Grounded shapes and correct contact and proportions, white backdrop.
attempts.review: Els topalls petits de fusta que sostenen el pal a la primera vinyeta desapareixen de la rampa a les altres dues. El canvi afecta just el mecanisme que s’ha de seguir.

attempts.prompt: Generate exactly one finished raster illustration for classroom causal reasoning. Landscape canvas, three equally wide side-by-side panels with broad pure white gutters and generous outer margins. Photorealistic synthetic white-background studio photography of one natural adult man in plain clothes. Correct human anatomy and grip. Same agent and exact fixed 3/4 camera, light direction, scene layout, object sizes and geometry across the panels. Maximize legibility of the contact point and result while leaving margins around every object and body. Use minimal supports and white backdrop. Catalan brief, interpret in the pictures: LEFT state of departure: Un pal travesser impedeix que un cotxe de joguina baixi per la rampa. CENTER explicit physical cause: Aixeca el pal pels extrems. El cotxe comença a passar per l’espai obert sota el pal. RIGHT consequence: El cotxe és al peu de la rampa. El pal continua alçat a la mateixa alçada. Continuity and object accounting: Un cotxe amb capó vermell, un pal rom i una rampa curta amb vores. Show the same yellow-railed ramp in all three panels. Two short wooden pairs of fixed pegs form UPWARD-OPEN forks on top of the rails, cradling a removable cylindrical crossbar laterally across the ramp in the first panel. Exactly the same four pegs stay in place entirely visible in the middle and right panel. No closed holes. The bar simply lifts vertically out of the open forks; unobstructed pair of empty forks is visible after. Same side three-quarter camera, the car visibly blocked at bumper height left, moving just below forks center, and fully at bottom of unchanged ramp right. No graphic arrows, movement lines, words, letters, numbers, signage, logo or watermark. Keep all object edges, hand contact and supports physically coherent. Three panels, readable left to right.
attempts.review: Els dos suports ara es conserven, però el pal inicial queda per sota de les forquilles obertes i no s’hi recolza. Cal un topall amb els dos recolzaments visibles i a l’altura del para-xocs.

attempts.prompt: Create ONE wide educational raster stimulus with three equal side-by-side panels, large white gutters and margins, white studio background, exactly the same single actor and all the same props with identical scale, perspective, viewing angle and lighting throughout. Synthetic photorealistic studio photography with one natural adult man with realistic skin, clothing, anatomy, grip and reach. Draw or photograph the following Catalan causal brief without writing any words. LEFT baseline: Un pal travesser impedeix que un cotxe de joguina baixi per la rampa. CENTER show the exact physical contact mechanism and onset of the change, with the relevant parts fully visible: Aixeca el pal pels extrems. El cotxe comença a passar per l’espai obert sota el pal. RIGHT result: El cotxe és al peu de la rampa. El pal continua alçat a la mateixa alçada. Continuity and accounting: Un cotxe amb capó vermell, un pal rom i una rampa curta amb vores. Fully visible hands, joints, support, edges and all the objects, enough free space around the figures, exact object dimensions and quantities. Keep the same props and furniture in all three panels. No graphics, arrows, motion lines, words, letters, digits, logos or watermark. Wide horizontal image. Specific production fix: A carpenter-made yellow-railed short wooden ramp. A short wooden rectangular crossbar rests horizontally on top of two stable chunky wooden upright blocks at the top, one on each side, a clear flat top supports each end of crossbar. Show side-front view so the top contacts are unmistakable. The toy car’s front bumper touches the crossbar in the first panel. Lift in the second exposing separated flat wooden tops; space underneath allows car to pass. Identical blocks and ramp all three panels. No holes, hooks, forks, or extra pegs. Agent’s hands never touch the car.
attempts.review: El pal reposa sobre els dos suports, però queda per damunt del sostre del cotxe. La posició inicial permet que el vehicle hi passi per sota sense que ningú l’aixequi.
